saw_lines: Sport glasses get bought after a bad fall or a broken pair, so the buyer asks whether it survives the trail.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a buyer hears that the glasses survive a fall.
Your 11 of 22 copy ads open on the same unbreakable sunglasses line. Run three new openers on the ultralight frame, the seconds fit and fishing hook protection.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: 11 of 22 copy ads open on one line about unbreakable sunglasses, so buyers meet the same pitch and scroll on. Your ultralight frame and seconds fit never lead. Run three new openers on those, plus fishing hook protection.

None of your 30 ads mention shipping or delivery, though your policy page answers it. A new buyer who wonders how the glasses arrive leaves first. Open ads for new buyers with the shipping time and cost from that page.

11 of your 22 copy ads run one identical text, so the same paragraph repeats across the feed with nothing new to act on. Keep that copy, but change the opening line and the creative in each of the 11.

None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so every claim rests on words alone. Collect one number, a review count or pairs shipped, and lead with it. Until then, open with the customer quotes on your site.
